game_title: Condition Builder – Torchlit Cave Mouth Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the torchbearer must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the loop_runs value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about loop_runs to power up the torchbearer and open the lantern post.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Condition Builder
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Torchlit Cave Mouth.
